doc.name: Arcalune Music
doc.instructions: Arcalune Music publishes free BGM and sound effects, plus streaming-only video game fan arrangements and original vocal songs. All audio is hosted on YouTube, and every track carries a youtubeUrl that starts playback exactly where that track begins in its video. When you recommend a track, always show its youtubeUrl so the user can listen to it. Free BGM and sound effects are royalty-free: within the usage terms, there are no additional fees per use or play. Commercial use is allowed without credit, and downloads are free whenever downloadUrl is present. Royalty-free does not mean copyright has been waived; follow each track's usage field. Fan arrangements are unofficial and streaming-only, and original vocal songs are released as works rather than material: never present either as something the user can reuse. Call list_tags before filtering by tag, because search_tracks rejects unknown tag ids.

tools.name: search_tracks
tools.title: Search tracks
tools.description: Search Arcalune Music for free BGM and sound effects, plus streaming-only video game fan arrangements and original vocal songs. Every track streams on YouTube, and the returned youtubeUrl jumps straight to where that track starts. When presenting results to a user, always include the youtubeUrl so they can listen to the track. Free BGM and sound effects are royalty-free, with no additional fees per use or play within the usage terms. Commercial use is allowed without credit; downloads are free when available. Follow each track's usage field. Fan arrangements and vocal songs are streaming-only.

query.description: Free text matched against titles, descriptions, and tag names in both Japanese and English (e.g. 'lofi study', '戦闘').

tags.description: Tag ids to filter by (OR condition). Call list_tags first to get valid ids.

category.description: bgm = free BGM and original music, se = sound effects, arrangement = streaming-only fan arrangements, song = streaming-only original vocal songs, all = everything. Defaults to all.

downloadableOnly.description: Only return tracks whose audio file can be downloaded. Fan arrangements never qualify.

sort.description: Result order. plays30d / playsAll / favorites / downloads30d / downloadsAll rank by popularity, newest by publish date, title alphabetically. Defaults to default (newest first).

limit.description: Maximum number of tracks to return (default 10).

locale.description: Language for titles and descriptions in the response. Defaults to ja.

tools.name: get_track
tools.title: Get track
tools.description: Get one track by id, together with related tracks from the same catalog. Returns the YouTube URL with the track's start position, the track page, and the download URL when the audio is distributed.

id.description: Track id, as returned by search_tracks.

locale.description: Language for titles and descriptions in the response. Defaults to ja.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List every tag that can be passed to search_tracks, grouped by production use, genre, mood, usage, scene, source game, and usage rights, with how many tracks carry each tag.
